required_output: 真实曲目、筛选、版本信息和可用资源入口。
implementation: Six version-specific center resources render with source-bounded search, publisher-level and playing-goal filters, reasons, access and exact external links.

required_output: sad 分区有实际曲目和适合演奏的依据；不能只给纯聆听歌单。
implementation: The reflective filter returns the checked Gymnopédie edition and keeps mood language explicitly editorial.

required_output: 明确 cool/fun 的推荐依据，不作搜索量或用户偏好的客观排名承诺。
implementation: The cheerful/playful filter returns The Happy Farmer and Addams Family Theme with separate version reasons.

required_output: beautiful 的主观选择标准和具体曲目，不能只更换形容词。
implementation: The spacious-sound filter returns the checked Gymnopédie edition without presenting beauty as a ranking.

required_output: 中级曲目对应具体版本和难点，不用泛 easy 列表代替。
implementation: The intermediate filter returns the exact late-intermediate and intermediate editions with their publisher label basis.

required_output: happy 条件有对应曲目与选择说明。
implementation: The cheerful filter includes a real matching edition and the source happy guidance remains visible.

required_output: 介绍作品类型并连接可弹的实际例子，不只做一个标签。
implementation: The source Types of piece block stays visible and connects the six actual formats without opening topic routes.

required_output: 弹唱条件有可用的伴奏/lead sheet/教程入口，不拿独奏谱直接代替。
implementation: The sing-and-play filter returns the piano/vocal All of Me edition and does not substitute a solo score.

required_output: 明确适用水平、前置能力、具体版本和可开始的资源。
implementation: Nine featured versions plus fifty exact titles from one named Easy Piano collection render with version and access boundaries; no top-50 or per-track review claim.

required_output: 儿童条件对应实际曲目与适用说明；不是与成人词视为同义。
implementation: The children view returns Hot Cross Buns, early Twinkle and early Happy Birthday versions.

required_output: C 大调条件依据具体版本的调性核对，不把调性直接当作难度评级。
implementation: The C-major view returns only the three featured editions whose source key is C major.

required_output: 同时满足易弹和优美选择条件；给曲目和理由。
implementation: The gentle view compares two distinct Twinkle arrangements without merging their levels or access terms.

required_output: 成人条件对应曲目与选择说明；不自动套儿童教材。
implementation: The adult-method view returns two named works from Alfred’s matching Book 1 supplement.

required_output: 演出效果/看起来难的查询以具体选择理由承接，不承诺学习结果。
implementation: The small-performance view returns Happy Birthday and Jingle Bells with occasion-based reasons and no outcome guarantee.
